This is my small perennial plot — I think it is my coffee and some fruit trees near the house, less than a quarter hectare. I am old now, 71 years, and I do not have cash to waste on fertilizer for trees that have been there many years. I will put the cattle manure and household compost around the trees like I always do, and pull weeds by hand when my grandchildren can help. The rains come on their own here in Oromia, so I do not need to water, and I do not spray chemicals — I have never done that on the coffee and fruit.
